text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein says priority should be given to the armed forces in addition to food.
- Foreign minister holds talks with members of U.N. Security Council in New York.
- Aziz receives former Algerian President Ahmed Ben Bella.
- Editorial urges U.S. to start dialogue with Iraq.
- Article on the mother of all battles and the future awaiting the Arab nation.
- Egyptian workers demand lifting of sanctions on Iraq.
- Iraq exports additional amounts of oil.
- British organisation criticises (U.N. arms inspector) Rolf Ekeus.
